scripts.build: npx -y rimraf dist && npx -y shx mkdir -p dist && npx -y shx cp index.html robots.txt 2026_script.js pwa-handler.js manifest.json sw.js _redirects icone_logo.png ui-kit.css ui-kit.js dist/ && npx -y shx cp -r icons dist/ && npx -y shx cp -r public dist/
scripts.build:netlify: npm run build && sed -i "s|___SUPABASE_URL___|${SUPABASE_URL}|g" dist/2026_script.js && sed -i "s|___SUPABASE_KEY___|${SUPABASE_KEY}|g" dist/2026_script.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y gh-pages -d dist -b 2026Infra -r https://github.com/repositoriocpd-cpu/2026Infra.git
